# Weekly roll-up ruling (e2e agentic synthetic)

Tanya (team owner) ruled on how the week's reactions reach people:

> the per-run bundle stays, and on Fridays we add one roll-up of the week —
> what moved, what is still open — instead of asking anyone to scroll back

Tina asked whether the roll-up replaces the per-run bundle. Tanya held that it
does not: the bundle is for the run, the roll-up is for the week. Rejected: a
daily digest, because most days carry a single run and it would repeat the
bundle word for word.

positions.name: ReactionRollupCadence
positions.frame: How should reaction updates and summaries be cadenced across run and weekly cycles to prevent scroll-back without creating redundancy?
positions.why: The dialogue establishes artifact scope across temporal cadences—maintaining separate roles for immediate per-run reaction bundles and Friday weekly roll-ups, while ruling out daily digests due to single-run redundancy.

placements.why: The ruling directly targets the failure mode of decisions and context evaporating into chat scroll-back, establishing structured temporal cadences (per-run bundle vs. Friday weekly roll-up) so team members do not have to scroll back to track what moved or remained open.
